Thank you to Mayora Donrio for believing in the potential of our youth and for giving them opportunities like this.

To our LYDO, Sir Matt Gregg Aying, thank you for being our partner in this activity and for your continued commitment to the youth.

To our lecturer, Sir Lucky, thank you for sharing your talent, patience, and knowledge with our young artists.

And of course, to our Tourism Team, thank you for the hard work and dedication in making this activity possible.

Padayon, Kabataan! Keep creating, keep expressing, and keep adding color to Titay. 🎨❤️

Blessing & Turnover of the New Firetruck 🚒

A meaningful day for the Municipality of Titay as we officially welcome and turn over our new Firetruck—a much-needed addition to strengthen our emergency response and fire protection capabilities.

Our heartfelt gratitude to Mayor Riorita “DONRIO” Martinez Castillo, RPh, for making the acquisition of this firetruck a priority and for her unwavering commitment to the safety and welfare of every Titayanon.

We likewise extend our sincere appreciation to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), particularly SFO4 Neil Siaron, together with FSSUPT Nazrudyn M. Cablayan, DSC, FSSUPT Jacqueline S. Ortega, DSC, FSUPT Wilfredo A. David, DSC, and FSUPT Reggy A. Olmedo, DSC, for your invaluable support and dedication to strengthening fire protection and emergency response in our municipality.

Above all, our deepest gratitude to DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla for his support and for helping make this much-needed firetruck a reality for the people of Titay.

This firetruck is more than just equipment—it is an investment in safety, preparedness, and the protection of our people.

Daghang salamat sa tanan nga mitabang aron matuman kini nga panalangin para sa atong lungsod. Padayon ta sa pagserbisyo ug pagpanalipod sa matag Titayanon! ❤️🚒

The activity equipped young leaders with essential knowledge and practical skills in fire prevention, basic firefighting, rescue, first aid, and Exit Drill in the Home (EDITH), empowering them to become active advocates of safety and preparedness in their schools, homes, and communities.

The activity aimed to strengthen the knowledge, skills, and preparedness of student leaders in preventing and responding to fire and other emergencies. It provided participants with practical lessons and demonstrations on basic firefighting, rescue techniques, first aid, and Exit Drill in the Home (EDITH).

Adding an interactive approach to fire safety education, BFP Titay also facilitated online fire safety games, allowing participants to test and reinforce their knowledge through engaging and interactive activities.

The Fire Square Roadshow emphasized the important role of students as fire safety advocates and responsible members of the community. By equipping young leaders with essential fire safety knowledge and emergency response skills, the BFP seeks to help build a culture of preparedness and strengthen community resilience.

✅ Stay calm and avoid spreading unverified information.

✅ Prepare and maintain your emergency go bag.
✅ During strong earthquakes, remember: DROP, COVER, and HOLD ON.
